description: Reconciliation specification for unifying a heterogeneous Parquet data warehouse into a single canonical dataset.

amount_cents.description: Convert integer cents to float64 dollar amounts

type_promotions.string_to_int64: Parse numeric string transaction IDs to int64
type_promotions.int8_to_bool: Convert int8 fraud indicator (0/nonzero) to boolean
type_promotions.float32_to_float64: Widen float32 risk scores to float64
type_promotions.large_string_to_string: Normalize large_string columns to standard string
type_promotions.dictionary_to_plain: Decode dictionary-encoded string columns to plain strings
type_promotions.timestamp_to_utc_us: Convert all timestamps to microsecond-precision UTC. Timezone-naive timestamps should be assumed UTC.

missing_columns: Fill absent columns with typed null arrays of appropriate length
